document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  function applyResponsiveHeadings() {
    var title = document.querySelector('.title__heading');
    var service = document.querySelector('.service__heading');
    var isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 999;

    if (title) {
      if (!title.dataset.originalText) {
        title.dataset.originalText = title.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      }

      if (isMobile) {
        var words = title.dataset.originalText.split(' ');

        if (words.length >= 3) {
          var firstLine = words.slice(0, -2).join(' ');
          var secondLine = words.slice(-2).join(' ');

          title.innerHTML = firstLine + ' <span class="title-second-line">' + secondLine + '</span>';
        }
      } else {
        title.textContent = title.dataset.originalText;
      }
    }

    if (service) {
      if (!service.dataset.originalText) {
        service.dataset.originalText = service.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      }

      if (isMobile) {
        var parts = service.dataset.originalText
          .split('•')
          .map(function(part) {
            return part.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        service.innerHTML = parts
          .map(function(part) {
            return '<span class="service-line">' + part + '</span>';
          })
          .join('');
      } else {
        service.textContent = service.dataset.originalText;
      }
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('custom-mobile-headings-style')) {
      var style = document.createElement('style');
      style.id = 'custom-mobile-headings-style';
      style.innerHTML = `
        @media (max-width: 999px) {
          .title__heading .title-second-line {
            display: block;
            margin-top: 5px;
          }

          .service__heading .service-line {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
          }
        }
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
  }

  applyResponsiveHeadings();
  window.addEventListener('resize', applyResponsiveHeadings);
});

	<h3>How much does a website design project cost?</h3>
<p>The cost of a website design project depends on your unique goals and requirements. Factors such as the number of pages, custom functionality, eCommerce features, and integrations all influence the final investment. At San Diego Web Studios, we’ll take the time to understand your business and provide a competitive, detailed proposal with transparent pricing for your consideration.</p>
<h3>How long does the web design process take?</h3>
<p>Every web design project is different, but most websites are completed within 4 to 6 weeks. Sometimes, projects are super simple and can be done in a week or two. If you need your project delivered sooner, just let us know, and we will allocate additional resources to meet your deadline. Larger or more complex projects may require additional time depending on scope, content, and feedback throughout the process. The team at San Diego Web Studios will provide a clear timeline at the start and keep you updated every step of the way.</p>
<h3>Will my new website be optimized for SEO, AI visibility, and mobile devices?</h3>
<p>Yes. Every website we design and develop at San Diego Web Studios is fully responsive, ensuring your website looks and performs great on desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. We also build every site using best practices, including fast loading speeds, a clean site structure, optimized page titles, meta descriptions, and a solid technical foundation designed to help search engines understand and index your website.</p>
<h3>Can I update my website after it goes live?</h3>
<p>Yes. We build all of our websites in such a way that a junior-level WordPress user or a tech-forward individual can find their way around and make edits, changes, and add new pages themselves. Our team is available to help you as much or as little as you would like.     height: 100%;
}

.lift-image-wrapper {
    overflow: hidden;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lift-image-wrapper img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    object-fit: cover;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 1.25s cubic-bezier(.2, .75, .5, 1), opacity .5s ease .3s;
}

.lift-item:hover .lift-image-wrapper img {
    transform: scale(1.13) !important;
}

.lift-item p {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 10px 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 13px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .11) !important;
    font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    line-height: 1.2em !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #000000;

    display: flex !important;
    flex: 1;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;

    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .lift-portfolio {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 20px;
    }

    .lift-item p {
        padding-left: 5px !important;
        padding-right: 5px !important;
    }

    body.home .lift-portfolio .lift-item:last-child {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

      if (!title.dataset.originalText) {
        title.dataset.originalText = title.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      }

      if (isMobile) {
        var words = title.dataset.originalText.split(' ');

          var firstLine = words.slice(0, -2).join(' ');

          title.innerHTML = firstLine + ' <span class="title-second-line">' + secondLine + '</span>';
        }
      } else {
        title.textContent = title.dataset.originalText;
      }
    }

        service.dataset.originalText = service.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      }

      if (isMobile) {
        var parts = service.dataset.originalText
          .split('•')
          .map(function(part) {
            return part.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        service.innerHTML = parts
          .map(function(part) {
            return '<span class="service-line">' + part + '</span>';
          })
          .join('');
      } else {
        service.textContent = service.dataset.originalText;

            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
          }
        }
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
  }

});
